notes: VAT 10% only on dealer's value added (direct method), not gold value; imported unworked gold 0%. SJC premium is the single tael (37.5g) price vs world price, PNJ board 27 Nov 2026. Buyback 3.68% and jewellery 4.20% calculated from PNJ buy/sell that day. Bar import duty not found (SBV licence regime), null. New 0.1% PIT on bar transfers is in law from Jul 2026 but MoF says not yet collected.
